Al-free sample; water inferred from volume calibration, not directly measured by SIMS/IR/TGA on this specimen. Raman confirms structural OH qualitatively. Preserve Table 1 Si0.954O2H0.184: its mass-equivalent H2O is about 2.81 wt%, within the reported 3.2(5) wt% range but not exactly its central value. H retention at high pressure is inferred, not measured. No atomic coordinates were refined (Section 2). The 28-42 GPa interval is two-phase coexistence, excluded from both hydrous EOS fits. CaCl2-type Pnnm denotes the Si-O framework refinement model; hydrogen ordering and a possible delta-AlOOH-related subgroup are unresolved (Section 3.2). BM2 means fixed K0\_prime=4; V0 is an extrapolation to zero pressure. Structural reference cell is measured at 47.57 GPa, not the EOS V0. Diffraction uses the explicitly limited peak-position fallback described in source.structure.

<details markdown="1">
<summary>Parameter provenance</summary>

- **Origin of the parameterization:** Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Sections 2, 3.1-3.3 and 4.2; Tables 1-4; Figures 2-5; Erratum, page 6983; Supporting Text S1 and Tables S1-S4.
- **Equation:** Section 3.3 cites Birch (1978): P=3K0/2\*(eta^7-eta^5)\*\[1+3/4\*(K0\_prime-4)\*(eta^2-1)\], eta=(V0/V)^(1/3). K0\_prime=4 reduces exactly to BM2. No thermal term.
- **V0:** Table 4: fitted, extrapolated zero-pressure conventional cell, not a recovered phase volume.
- **K0:** Table 4
- **K0 prime:** Section 3.3: fixed 4 for CaCl2 type; fixed 4.59 adopted from Andrault et al. (2003) for both stishovites.
- **Uncertainty:** Tables 3-4: estimated 1 sigma. No source covariance or weighting protocol. Null fixed-parameter errors do not mean error-free measurement.
- **Volume normalization:** angstrom cubed per conventional primitive rutile/orthorhombic cell, Z=2; no molar or atom conversion.

</details>
